root_causes.description: The workflow says speculative prerequisites should be dismissed, but it does not impose a mechanical admission test before a secondary candidate can enter Material findings.
The workflow does not explicitly prohibit using hypothetical failure of a supplied upstream contract, such as requireAuth, as evidence for a downstream finding.
Knowing one operand type while the other operand type is unobserved was still treated as affirmative evidence for a mismatch.
Satisfied-invariant language remains advisory enough that the model continues broad defect hunting and can override the intended no-finding stop.

successor_requirements: Introduce a mandatory evidence-admission gate before Material findings.
Every essential prerequisite of a LIKELY or CONFIRMED finding must have an explicit supplied/observed evidence anchor; unknown is not affirmative evidence.

A supplied upstream contract is presumed operative within the supplied scope unless contradictory supplied/observed evidence establishes bypass or failure; hypothetical failure of that contract cannot support a finding.
A type mismatch requires evidence for the actual types of both relevant values, not a framework fact for one operand plus speculation about the other.

When the target invariant is directly satisfied and no contradictory evidence exists, enter SATISFIED_INVARIANT_MODE: no adjacent material finding may be emitted unless it passes the stricter evidence-admission gate independently.
If no candidate passes, Material findings must be empty and ship recommendation must be NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_FOUND for the reviewed scope.
Preserve BOUNDARY-UNKNOWN LIKELY/REVIEW_REQUIRED behavior and FULL-CHAIN CONFIRMED/BLOCK behavior.
